_comment: SAPM Metrics Definitions — authoritative list of metrics published by agents, frontend, and infra for observability.

metrics.name: sapm_forecast_latency_ms
metrics.description: End-to-end latency of a single forecast generation cycle from input receipt to decision output

metrics.name: sapm_tx_success_rate
metrics.description: Rolling success rate (%) of submitted Sui transactions with execution status 'success' within 30s

metrics.name: sapm_rpc_error_rate
metrics.description: Rolling error rate (%) of Sui RPC calls returning non-200 or timeout

metrics.name: sapm_circuit_breaker_state
metrics.description: Current circuit breaker state per market: 0=closed (healthy), 1=open (tripped)

metrics.name: sapm_agent_loop_error_rate
metrics.description: Rolling error rate (%) of agent decision loop iterations that result in unhandled exception or circuit-breaker trip

metrics.name: sapm_lifecycle_restart_count
metrics.description: Total number of provider lifecycle restarts since process start

metrics.name: sapm_frontend_availability
metrics.description: Synthetic probe success rate (%) for the markets frontend route
